scope: Initial native install and all subsequent first-login and configuration workflows

groups.name: Fresh setup, Git import, credential selection, HTTP context, recovery, optional features
Real Git sync and MCP configuration in workspace
Real bounded search download and cancellation
Account, backup/restore, transfer, preferences, status settings

otherChecks.name: Packaged installer smoke (TTY account/password, curl/wget, repeat install, alternate-origin login and binding)
Actual offline CPython/CPU/model package installation and restart
Restored storage retry regression plus existing platform setup

findings.title: Changing a saved Git credential platform or authentication type incorrectly offered to retain the old secret
findings.fix: Only allow blank secret for unchanged platform and authentication type; otherwise require new secret and show correct help.

findings.title: A saved knowledge root unavailable at service startup could not recover through the webpage after the directory returned
findings.fix: Authenticated status checks retry the existing serialized activation; do not create a missing directory or replace an active runtime.

findings.title: Onboarding browser tests shared one database across independent cases and projects
findings.fix: Test-only reset creates a fresh owner/database/library for independent scenarios; update legacy assertions for current permission settings and rich editor.

limits: Git browser tests execute actual Git against isolated local bare repositories; GitHub/Gitee remote authentication is not re-tested using user credentials.
Optional-feature browser failure/progress cases use controlled responses; separate backend and workspace tests cover real plugin artifacts and actual local search installation/download.
A real ChatGPT client connection and public HTTPS/OAuth callback reachability require the user deployment and were not performed.
failureHistory: Early fixture failures were diagnosed and corrected; final results combine the unchanged passing cases with the latest successful targeted rechecks.
